name: calandria-desktop
description: Spike: Electron shell around the local Calandria server. Deliberately its own package so Electron (~280 MB unpacked) never lands in the app's node_modules, the Docker build, or CI.

scripts.dist:linux: npm run payload && electron-builder --linux dir deb AppImage
scripts.dist:mac: npm run payload && electron-builder --mac dir dmg zip
scripts.dist:win: npm run payload && electron-builder --win nsis zip

author: Calandria contributors
